title: Optical coherence tomography classifications of diabetic macular edema and response to aflibercept: One-year follow-up outcomes in a Chinese population

groups.description: DME with a diffuse retinal thickening pattern on baseline SD-OCT (Cirrus HD-OCT 5000), 40 eyes; five monthly aflibercept injections (baseline and months 1-4), then follow-up every 1-2 months with additional injections for visual acuity loss of more than 5 letters or a CMT increase of more than 10%; retrospective consecutive cohort (Suzhou Municipal Hospital, September 2020 to December 2021), NPDR, CMT above 300 um.

DME with a cystoid macular edema pattern on baseline SD-OCT, 46 eyes; five monthly aflibercept injections (baseline and months 1-4), then follow-up every 1-2 months with additional injections for visual acuity loss of more than 5 letters or a CMT increase of more than 10%; retrospective consecutive cohort (Suzhou Municipal Hospital, September 2020 to December 2021), NPDR, CMT above 300 um.

DME with serous retinal detachment on baseline SD-OCT (alone or with DRT or CME), 44 eyes; five monthly aflibercept injections (baseline and months 1-4), then follow-up every 1-2 months with additional injections for visual acuity loss of more than 5 letters or a CMT increase of more than 10%; retrospective consecutive cohort (Suzhou Municipal Hospital, September 2020 to December 2021), NPDR, CMT above 300 um.

notes: Unit: logMAR (Table 2 column headers); BCVA was measured with an international standard visual acuity chart and converted to logMAR for the analysis (Methods 2.3 and 2.4); no Snellen or decimal row.

Groups are subgroups defined by the baseline OCT pattern (control); together they form the whole cohort (130 eyes of 95 consecutive patients, some patients contributing both eyes). No whole-cohort acuity series is tabulated.

Follow-up: the design paragraph describes a 12-month follow-up and the inclusion criteria require willingness and ability to receive regular follow-up, without a minimum follow-up or a completed-follow-up analysis set; the consecutive cohort is kept with this note.
Regimen loading_then_prn: five monthly loading injections, then injections for the stated acuity or CMT criteria (mean injection counts per group in the Results).
Role control: approved agent, no experimental arm.
Central macular thickness (Table 3) and OCT biomarkers (Table 1) are reported in the article and mentioned here only.
